title: Can I SURVIVE Spell Chess?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Spell Chess against higher-rated humans. Each turn a player may cast a spell before moving: a Jump spell lets a piece jump over one piece as if it weren't there, and a Freeze spell freezes a 3x3 area so pieces there can't move next turn. Spells recharge after three turns and the same spell can't be used twice in a row. Kings can actually be captured via jump spells. He loses game 1 to a 2200 using a known jump-spell trap, then reuses the trap (Qh5 + jump) to win, finishing with four wins.
rules: Standard chess plus spells; before your move you may cast one spell.
Jump spell: a chosen piece can move through/jump over a blocking piece as if it weren't there this turn.
Freeze spell: freezes a 3x3 area; pieces in it cannot move on the next turn.
Each spell recharges after 3 turns, and you can't use the same spell twice in a row (limited spell count per game on chess.com, inferred).
Kings can be captured (e.g. by jumping over a blocker); capturing the king wins. Checkmate also wins.
You cast a spell and make one move; you can't move twice.
win_condition: Capture the king (via jump threats) or checkmate; goal 3 wins vs higher-rated humans.
